sloka: श्वः प्रभाते गमिष्यामः तद् आश्रम पदम् मम ।विश्वामित्रः वचः श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दशरधात्मजः ॥१-२६-३४॥
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte gamiṣyāmaḥ tad āśrama padam mama ।viśvāmitraḥ vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭo daśaradhātmajaḥ ॥1-26-34॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Viswamitra, Rama rejoiced and rested happily that night in the Tataka forest .
